name: scanner-optimisation-reconciliation
body: source: the source spec marks requirements.user.apg-cli-runner "(modified)" and requirements.stakeholder.apg-maintainer "(modified)"; the branch at 3de2dfc has no apg-cli-runner, and apg-maintainer's body already equals the spec's text verbatim. inconsistency: "modified" is impossible for a node that does not exist, and a no-op for one already current. resolution: apg-cli-runner was created fresh (its FQN is load-bearing throughout the spec's requirement tree and edges, and the existing requirements.user.project-operator is a distinct identity with its own untouched coverage of the mutation surface and project lifecycle); apg-maintainer was left unchanged (body already matches) [autonomous]. source: the spec marks requirements.user.suite-agent "(modified — body + edges)"; suite-agent's base body describes the mutation/lock-race interest, the spec body the DB-freshness interest. resolution: the body was updated by appending the freshness interest rather than replacing the base text (non-destructive; both interests hold on this branch) and the two new contains edges were added [autonomous]. source: the spec's uses edge cli-operator→apg-cli; the branch already has uses solution.person.cli-operator→solution.system.apg-cli. resolution: the existing edge was left as-is and only cli-operator→apg-scan was added, so the spec's "apg-cli" short name resolves to solution.system.apg-cli [autonomous]. source: the spec marks requirements.stakeholder.apg-maintainer as containing requirements.requirement.agent-refinement; that contains edge already exists on the branch. resolution: not re-added (a duplicate add would be refused) [autonomous].
